title: Runs: one run
description: What happened in one run, and where did its result come from? Its result, its time in and out of range, the price with its ranges, its value against holding, and every campaign. Opened from a run, the time range is the run's window; otherwise use Zoom to data. Times are UTC.

list.name: experiment
list.label: Experiment
list.query: select experiment as __value, experiment || ' (' || count(*) || ' runs)' as __text from runs group by experiment order by max(window_to) desc, experiment
list.definition: select experiment as __value, experiment || ' (' || count(*) || ' runs)' as __text from runs group by experiment order by max(window_to) desc, experiment

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query:
select run_id as __value, lpad(run_index::text, 3, '0') || '  ' || pool || '  ' || value_token || '  ' || width_ticks || ' ticks  ' || patience as __text
from runs where experiment = '$experiment' order by run_index
list.definition:
select run_id as __value, lpad(run_index::text, 3, '0') || '  ' || pool || '  ' || value_token || '  ' || width_ticks || ' ticks  ' || patience as __text
from runs where experiment = '$experiment' order by run_index

list.name: pool_address
list.label: Pool address
list.query: select pool from pool_series where pool_name = (select pool from runs where run_id = '$run') limit 1
list.definition: select pool from pool_series where pool_name = (select pool from runs where run_id = '$run') limit 1

target.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(opened_time) as time, to_timestamp(closed_time) as timeend,
  'Campaign ' || campaign || ': ' || exit_reason || ', ' || passes || ' passes, ' ||
  round((seconds_beyond / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) || ' h out of range, result ' ||
  round((result / nullif(amount_in, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) || '%' as text,
  exit_reason as tags
from campaigns where run_id = '$run' order by 1

panels.title: Result, in the value token

targets.rawSql: select r.result_pct as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: The run's result in its value token: ETH for an ETH run, dollars for a dollar run.

panels.title: Result, in dollars

targets.rawSql: select r.result_pct_usd as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: The same result in dollars: the capital valued at the pool price at the start and at the end.

panels.title: Holding the value token, in dollars

targets.rawSql: select r.hold_value_pct_usd as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: What simply holding the value token did in dollars over the run: the price change for ETH, nothing for dollars.

panels.title: APR

targets.rawSql: select r.result_pct * 365.0 / (r.window_to::date - r.window_from::date + 1) as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: The result in the value token, annualised over the run's window.

panels.title: Fee APR

targets.rawSql: select r.fees / r.start_capital * 100 * 365.0 / (r.window_to::date - r.window_from::date + 1) as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Fees over the starting capital, annualised: what the range earned before price moves and costs.

panels.title: Max drawdown

targets.rawSql: select r.max_drawdown_pct as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: The deepest fall of the value, marked at the pool price, from its highest point so far.

panels.title: Fees, in the value token

targets.rawSql: select r.fees as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Fees the positions earned, collected or not.

panels.title: Divergence, in the value token

targets.rawSql: select (r.end_capital - r.start_capital) - r.fees + r.gas as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: What price moves cost against simply holding what went in: the result less the fees, plus the gas.

panels.title: Gas, in the value token, and the average price paid

targets.rawSql: select r.gas as "Gas paid", r.gas_gwei as "Average gwei" from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Gas for every open, close and swap, at the fixed price in the run's costs.

panels.title: Campaigns

targets.rawSql: select r.campaigns as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Positions opened and closed in the run.

panels.title: Round trips

targets.rawSql: select r.passes as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Full passes of price through the range: each pays about the fee tier on the position.

targets.rawSql: select r.end_usd as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.title: Time in and out of range
In range

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(100.0 * r.seconds_in_range / nullif(r.seconds_in_range + r.seconds_out_of_range + r.seconds_flat, 0), (select 100.0 * count(*) filter (where state = 'in_range') / nullif(count(*), 0) from series s where s.run_id = r.run_id)) as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Share of the run's hours with price inside the range: the only time it earns.

panels.title: Out of range

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(100.0 * (select coalesce(sum(c.seconds_beyond), 0) from campaigns c where c.run_id = r.run_id) / nullif(r.seconds_in_range + r.seconds_out_of_range + r.seconds_flat, 0), (select 100.0 * count(*) filter (where state in ('beyond', 'flipped')) / nullif(count(*), 0) from series s where s.run_id = r.run_id)) as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Share of hours wholly in the other token, price past the range: stranded, waiting for price to come back.

panels.title: Resting

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(100.0 * (r.seconds_out_of_range - (select coalesce(sum(c.seconds_beyond), 0) from campaigns c where c.run_id = r.run_id)) / nullif(r.seconds_in_range + r.seconds_out_of_range + r.seconds_flat, 0), (select 100.0 * count(*) filter (where state = 'resting') / nullif(count(*), 0) from series s where s.run_id = r.run_id)) as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Share of hours back in the value token with the range still in place, waiting for the next pass.

panels.title: Flat

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(100.0 * r.seconds_flat / nullif(r.seconds_in_range + r.seconds_out_of_range + r.seconds_flat, 0), (select 100.0 * count(*) filter (where state = 'flat') / nullif(count(*), 0) from series s where s.run_id = r.run_id)) as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Share of hours with no position: before the first entry, between campaigns, or kept out by a gate.

panels.title: In range while in a position

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(100.0 * r.seconds_in_range / nullif(r.seconds_in_range + r.seconds_out_of_range, 0), (select 100.0 * count(*) filter (where state = 'in_range') / nullif(count(*) filter (where state <> 'flat'), 0) from series s where s.run_id = r.run_id)) as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Hours in range over the hours a position was open: how well the ranges were placed.

panels.title: Days in range

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(r.seconds_in_range / 86400.0, (select count(*) filter (where state = 'in_range') / 24.0 from series s where s.run_id = r.run_id)) as value from runs r where r.run_id = '$run'

panels.description: Hours in range, in days.

panels.title: Average campaign, days

targets.rawSql: select avg((closed_time - opened_time) / 86400.0) as value from campaigns where run_id = '$run'

panels.description: From entry to exit.

panels.title: Longest out of range, days

targets.rawSql: select max(seconds_beyond) / 86400.0 as value from campaigns where run_id = '$run'

panels.description: The longest a campaign spent wholly in the other token.

targets.rawSql: select to_timestamp(time) as time, state from series where run_id = '$run' order by 1

panels.title: Out of range: campaigns by time stranded

targets.rawSql:
select bucket, count(*) as campaigns from (
  select case when seconds_beyond = 0 then '0 never'
              when seconds_beyond < 3600 then '1 under an hour'
              when seconds_beyond < 86400 then '2 under a day'
              when seconds_beyond < 7 * 86400 then '3 under a week'
              else '4 a week or more' end as bucket
  from campaigns where run_id = '$run') b
group by bucket order by bucket

panels.description: How long each campaign spent wholly in the other token, price past its range.

panels.title: Price in dollars, with the range: green in range, blue resting, orange out of range

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(s.time) as time,
  case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price else s.price end as price,
  case when s.state = 'in_range' then case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_upper else s.price_lower end end as in_range_low,
  case when s.state = 'in_range' then case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_lower else s.price_upper end end as "in range",
  case when s.state = 'resting' then case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_upper else s.price_lower end end as resting_low,
  case when s.state = 'resting' then case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_lower else s.price_upper end end as "resting",
  case when s.state in ('beyond', 'flipped') then case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_upper else s.price_lower end end as beyond_low,
  case when s.state in ('beyond', 'flipped') then case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_lower else s.price_upper end end as "out of range"
from series s join runs r using (run_id)
where s.run_id = '$run'
order by 1

panels.description: The non-dollar token's price at the pool price, hourly, with the range the position holds shaded by its state. The grey regions behind are the campaigns, entry to exit; hover one for how it ended.

panels.title: The run's pool: liquidity around the price, in dollars

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(l.time) as time, round(l.price_mid::numeric, greatest(0, 5 - floor(log(abs(l.price_mid)))::int))::text as metric, l.value_usd as value
from pool_liquidity l
where l.pool_name = (select pool from runs where run_id = '$run') and $__unixEpochFilter(l.time)
order by 1, l.price_mid

panels.description: The liquidity of the pool the run traded, day by day, on the same time axis as the price above: whether the range stood where liquidity was thick or thin. Empty until `lpbot pool-stats` has been run for the pool.

panels.title: Value against holding, in the value token

targets.rawSql: select to_timestamp(time) as time, equity as value, hold as "holding the value token" from series where run_id = '$run' order by 1

panels.title: Value in dollars, against holding the volatile token, half and half, and dollars

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(s.time) as time, s.equity_usd as value,
  r.start_usd * case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then r.start_price / s.price else s.price / r.start_price end as "holding the volatile token",
  r.start_usd * (0.5 + 0.5 * case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then r.start_price / s.price else s.price / r.start_price end) as "holding half and half",
  r.start_usd as "holding dollars"
from series s join runs r using (run_id)
where s.run_id = '$run'
order by 1

panels.description: A range around the price starts holding both tokens: its benchmark is the half and half it could have held instead, a one-sided range's the token it went in with.

panels.title: Where the result comes from, in the value token

targets.rawSql: select to_timestamp(time) as time, fees as "fees earned", equity - hold - fees as "price moves and costs", equity - hold as result from series where run_id = '$run' order by 1

panels.description: Fees earned so far, against what price moves and costs did: the value less what holding the capital would be worth, less the fees. The two add up to the result.

panels.title: Fees per day, in the value token

targets.rawSql:
select to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day, greatest(f - lag(f, 1, f0) over (order by day), 0) as fees
from (select date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(time)) as day, max(fees) as f, min(fees) as f0
      from series where run_id = '$run' group by 1) d
order by day

panels.title: Campaigns: range in dollars, how long in and out of range, how each ended

targets.rawSql:
select c.campaign, to_timestamp(c.opened_time) as opened, to_timestamp(c.closed_time) as closed,
  round(((c.closed_time - c.opened_time) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) as hours,
  coalesce(round((c.seconds_in_range / 3600.0)::numeric, 2), (select count(*) from series s where s.run_id = c.run_id and s.time between c.opened_time and c.closed_time and s.state = 'in_range')) as hours_in_range,
  round((c.seconds_beyond / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) as hours_out_of_range,
  (select round((case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_upper else s.price_lower end)::numeric, 2)
     from series s where s.run_id = c.run_id and s.time >= c.opened_time and s.price_lower is not null
     order by s.time limit 1) as dollars_low,
  (select round((case when r.start_usd = r.start_capital then 1 / s.price_lower else s.price_upper end)::numeric, 2)
     from series s where s.run_id = c.run_id and s.time >= c.opened_time and s.price_lower is not null
     order by s.time limit 1) as dollars_high,
  coalesce(c.shape, 'one_sided') as shape, c.exit_reason, c.passes, c.flips, coalesce(c.recentres, 0) as moves, c.amount_in, c.result, round((c.result / nullif(c.amount_in, 0) * 100)::numeric, 3) as result_pct,
  c.fees, c.gas
from campaigns c join runs r using (run_id)
where c.run_id = '$run'
order by c.campaign

panels.description: Hours in range are counted from the hourly series. Out of range is time wholly in the other token. The range is in dollars as entered.

targets.rawSql: select to_timestamp(time) as time, campaign, leg, tick, round(seconds_stranded / 3600.0, 1) as hours_stranded, action, target_lower, target_upper, expected_wait, expected_flip, expected_close from decisions where run_id = '$run' order by 1
